_comment: Frame registry. name -> IP (adb), profile (ha-config profiles key). Per-frame HA tokens live OUTSIDE the repo at ~/.config/frame-ha/<name>.json (url, token, frame). update-frame.sh fails hard if that file is missing - it never silently redeploys the previous frame's token. Fill IPs as each frame is taken over; DHCP-reserve each unit's wlan0 MAC.
